title: Kneser–Poulsen contraction conjecture
statement: In R³, moving the centers of congruent balls so that no pairwise distance increases cannot increase the volume of their union.

counterexample.description: Give algebraic centers of congruent balls in \(\mathbb R^3\) whose pairwise distances contract while union volume increases. Certified ball-union decomposition and interval algebra verify the strict gap.
